title: Baidu launches Unlimited OCR, a 3B param AI for seamless PDF #Baidu #UnlimitedOCR #AItechnology
description: Baidu released Unlimited OCR, a compact AI model capable of processing entire 100-page PDFs in a single pass. With only 3 billion parameters, it preserves tables, headings, clauses, formulas, and layout without splitting documents into pages. This approach eliminates the need for complex document pre-processing in RAG pipelines or search tools, enabling accurate and structured text extraction from scanned contracts and financial reports. Running locally and licensed under MIT, it ensures data privacy and is free for commercial use. Unlimited OCR represents a significant advancement in document digitization, optimizing workflows for businesses and developers working with large and complex PDF files. #Baidu #UnlimitedOCR #AI #OCRtechnology #DocumentProcessing #PDFextraction #AImodels #MachineLearning #MITLicense #DataPrivacy #RAGpipeline #FintechAI #ChineseTech #ArtificialIntelligence #TechInnovation
